clips.title: Update a yarn price and inspect its history
clips.description: Find the demo yarns, inspect their linked quality, change the weft rate from Rs 128 to Rs 140/kg, add a supplier note, and save. Open Activity to review the recorded change.

clips.title: Use the updated linked quality
clips.description: Reopen the saved quality and inspect its updated weft rate. Apply the recipe, check the yarn inputs, then review the recalculated live cost.

clips.title: Earlier costings keep their original figures
clips.description: Open the earlier saved costing. Its production cost remains Rs 33.23/m and its suggested price remains Rs 39.09/m. Updating Rate Book does not rewrite historical snapshots.
